verses.1: May God judge me! May my enemies be defeated by those who do not trust in deceitful people. May I be saved from their schemes.
verses.2: For you are the God of war! Why did you abandon me? Why do you walk in haste and despair?
verses.3: Send your light and your truth; they will guide me. They will bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwellings.
verses.4: And I will come before the temple of God, to that place of joy for my life. I will worship You in the sanctuary of God, my Lord.
verses.5: What shall I say to my soul? And what shall I do for God, since He still saves my face from destruction?
